opening.argument: The offer requires paid entry before participants can pursue the described mining and commission benefits: the speaker identifies Pool One at $500 plus a $99 registration fee as the minimum. Participation is then presented as a route to increased bitcoin-mining earnings, with the speaker stating that participants are “maximising your earnings ... for the bitcoin mining.” The presentation also ties promotion and higher pool participation to commissions, including eligibility for commissions across all three pools. Alongside the $500 entry route, it presents a $3,500 founder purchase as the preferred path to mining and commission benefits, while linking paid participation and wallet use to purported bonuses, token allocations, and future token or dividend benefits. It urges prompt enrollment, although the evidence does not independently verify those outcomes.
